svg.text: 3.2 × 2.8 km • Initial deployment • All units revealed for design review • North ↑
BLUE: AMERICAN / CANADIAN FRONT • RED: OCCUPATION DEFENSES
U = US squad • C = Canadian section • AT = antitank • S = scouts • M = mortar • T = Sherman • TR = transport
E = enemy rifle group • G = artillery • AX = tank • AC = armored car • F = collaborator • K = Klan auxiliary
Zigzags = trenches • Blue dashed = alternate approaches • Red dotted = local patrols • Grid = 400 m
E4 / E7 / E12 are sector reserves. Trench breaks preserve maneuver lanes. Unit icons are not to scale.
Provisional game layout: test sight lines, travel times, crossings and destruction before locking placements.
